description: This file defines the GLFace class, which models a polygon (triangle or quadrilateral) in 3D graphics, including vertex management, color setting, index calculations, and buffer preparation for rendering.

classes.name: GLFace
classes.description: Represents a polygon in 3D graphics with methods to add vertices, set color, compute indices, and prepare data for rendering.

methods.name: GLFace
methods.description: Default constructor for GLFace, initializes an empty face.

methods.name: GLFace
methods.description: Overloaded constructor for creating a triangular face with three vertices.

methods.name: GLFace
methods.description: Overloaded constructor for creating a quadrilateral face with four vertices.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a GLVertex to the face's vertex list.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color for the face's vertices, updating the last vertex if possible.

methods.name: getIndexCount
methods.description: Returns the number of indices needed to draw the face as triangles.

methods.name: putIndices
methods.description: Fills the provided ShortBuffer with index data for rendering the face as triangles.
